axes.name: code-review
axes.description: Re-review already-merged code for correctness, reuse and simplification findings.
axes.scope_boundary: Re-review already-merged code for correctness/simplification findings, file beads, never merge without normal review.

axes.name: dead-code
axes.description: Detect and remove code with zero live references.
axes.scope_boundary: Detect and remove code with zero live references, guarded by full test suite.

axes.name: architecture-debt
axes.description: Propose refactors for accumulated architecture debt.
axes.scope_boundary: Propose refactors, require PO sign-off before dispatch (design-tier by nature).

axes.name: ui-ux
axes.description: Improve UI/UX within the existing design governance tiers.
axes.scope_boundary: Only within existing DESIGN_GOVERNANCE.md tiers -- no new navigation/journeys without the existing PO+Benjamin gate.

axes.name: i18n
axes.scope_boundary: Translation completeness/consistency only, no copy rewrites.

axes.name: security
axes.description: Read-only security audits and small fixes.
axes.scope_boundary: Read-only audits + P0-P2 fixes only, no new auth providers without an explicit reserved decision.

axes.name: auth-providers
axes.description: Draft proposals for new login/auth providers.
axes.scope_boundary: Adding a new login provider is a reserved identity_and_consent-class decision under ADR-0015 Sec3, always asked, never assumed: this axis may draft a proposal, never ship one unreviewed.

axes.name: docs-debt
axes.scope_boundary: Keep CONTEXT_INDEX.md and ADRs current, no behavior change.

axes.name: v2-scope-exploration
axes.description: Draft-only speculative capabilities for a future version.
axes.scope_boundary: Draft-only speculative capabilities for a version that does not exist yet; may never be dispatched as executable work, only ever produces a document for the human to accept or reject.
